item.title: Countdown: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Dungeon Crawl #4 - Still An All-Timer

description.p: Forested Development.I left last week's Ocarina of Time feature feeling like I might have been a little too negative about the whole thing. Three weeks into my playthrough, and I had just poo-pooed back-to-back puzzle boxes. Well, fear not, because I'm swinging in the complete opposite direction this time.This is part four of my Dungeon Crawl series, where I revisit one OoT dungeon each week in the run-up to the Switch 2 remake. Just as with the previous three editions, I'm going into dungeon specifics here, so if you've never played OoT before and you are saving yourself for the remake, just know that there are spoilers ahead!Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo Of America's President Comments On The Possibility Of GTA 6 On Switch 2

description.p: Don't get your hopes up... yet.November is going to be one of the most significant periods in gaming history with the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. It's projected to be one of, if not the biggest entertainment launches of all time, beating out every game, book, or movie that's ever been released. Wowie-zowie.So naturally, many folks continue to question whether Rockstar's latest title will be coming to the Switch 2. After all, Nintendo's new console has proven itself more than capable of handling some of the most graphically-intensive games out there, so the possibility of a port in the future isn't entirely out of the question.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Wake Up, Samurai! Cyberpunk 2077 Is Getting A Live-Action Movie

description.p: But who will play Johnny Silverhand?Cyberpunk 2077 didn't get off to the best start when it originally launched in 2020, but it's now considered a success story. Since then, CD Projekt Red has polished it up, rolled out an animated Netflix series, and released a Switch 2 version of the title.A second game is also in development, and now, to add to all of this, a live-action movie set in the "Cyberpunk 2077" video game universe is in the works. According to the latest report, it's being done by Paramount Pictures, and "Transformers" movie producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is working alongside CDPR on the film.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Comes To Astral Ascent In New Crossover Update

description.p: For those who come after.We've been patiently hoping that Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 would make its way to Switch 2 ever since it consumed our every waking hour last year. Sandfall is still yet to make that happen, but in the meantime, we have a crossover with the wonderful roguelike Astral Ascent, which we can play right now.As revealed in today's Triple-i Initiative showcase, the sublime platforming roguelike has been treated to a bunch of crossover content from the land of Lumière. This includes three brand new bosses (Golgra, the Mime and Pétank), new rooms inspired by the game, and recruitable Expedition ally summons, each of which comes with its own special skills.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
